files_delete_description: This removes the folder and everything in it from your disk, and cannot be undone.

files_leave_error: Couldn't let go of that folder — try again

files_no_writing_description: There are files here, but none DyslexicWriter can open.
files_read_error: Couldn't read that folder — has it moved?

unsupported_description: DyslexicWriter saves straight to files on your computer, which needs the File System Access API. Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers support it; Firefox and Safari do not yet.
welcome_back_description: Open the folder you were writing in, or point us at a different one.
welcome_choose_description: Point us at any folder on your computer and use that one.
welcome_description: Choose a folder on your computer to keep your writing in. Your documents are saved there as ordinary markdown files, so they stay yours.
welcome_folder_blocked: That folder is protected by your browser. Documents, Downloads, the Desktop and your home folder can't be handed to an app — pick a folder inside one of them instead.
welcome_folder_create_error: Couldn't make a folder in there
welcome_folder_hint: Documents, Downloads and your home folder are protected by the browser — pick a folder inside one of those.
welcome_permission_denied: DyslexicWriter needs permission to use that folder
welcome_preview_prose: The stairs to the lantern room were never meant for a person carrying anything. Twenty-two of them, each one a hand's width narrower at the inside edge, spiralling up inside a tower built for the light and not for the keeper.
welcome_reopen_description: Pick up where you left off. Your browser needs a quick yes.
welcome_suggested_description: We'll make a DyslexicWriter folder inside the one you pick.
